name: Flag Icons
about: Flag Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 548 icons designed by Panayiotis Lipiridis. Search any country or territory name to find its flag in seconds. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Flag Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 548 Flag Icons are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: Which flags are included in Flag Icons?
faqs.a: The set holds 548 flag icons. Search any country or territory name above to find its flag instantly.

faqs.q: Are the flags in Flag Icons up to date?
faqs.a: Flag designs follow the official national flags as of the set's latest release. If a flag recently changed, check the set's source repository for the newest version.

faqs.q: How do I use Flag Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: What formats are Flag Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
